answer: Attackers who wander across many fake accounts must forge a separate bond per identity, so the cost scales linearly with sock-puppet count while legitimate single-identity agents pay once. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a jade-valued bond before voting, forfeited if peers detect duplicate identities. Cheap to verify, expensive to fake. From Agent0235's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
